citation: Farra SD, et al. Front Nutr 2023;10:1266422
protocol: Five maximal 1-km cycle sprints separated by 2 min active recovery, 1 h after placebo (PLA arm of a BCAA sports drink crossover); HR after each sprint, lactate before and after
population: 11 experienced cyclists (8 M, 3 F), 25 +/- 5 y, Pmax 283 +/- 79 W, VO2peak 46 +/- 11 mL/kg/min
note: Read placebo rows; lactate only pre and post; power output measured continuously.
